异界魅影逍遥 突发事故 名 3G 网首发

“当然是说真的了。”中年男子显然没有想到羿锋会这么说，他看着羿锋笑道。

羿锋斩钉截铁的说：“作为一个男人，我自然要保家卫国了。帝国的崛起，就是我的理想。帝国要我生，我就生，帝国要我牺牲，我义无反顾。我的理想，只为人民，只为帝国而存在，帝国是我的血液，帝国是我的最爱，帝国是……”

羿流听着羿锋连绵不绝，冠冕堂皇的话，脸色也微微红了起来。看着口水四射的小弟，忍不住心中鄙视道：妈啊，我怎么会有这么一个不要脸的小弟啊，他不脸红，我都为他脸红了。还保家卫国呢，我保证帝国要是出事了，你小子跑的比谁都快。

众人心底一致很感叹道：脸皮厚到这种程度，也是一种境界啊。

“行了，行了。贤侄，我知道你对帝国的忠心了，也知道你理想的远大了。你可以停下来了。”中年男子檫了一下额头上的冷汗，对羿锋这不要脸的炮击轰的恶心反胃。

假，太假了。怎么看你小子都是一个滑头，你要是真的这么伟大，那世界上就没公理了。

众人的脸也微微发烫了起来，尽管他们也时常虚伪，可是却从来没有虚伪到这种程度，一个个心底不住感叹：无耻无敌啊。我们还得慢慢修炼啊。

羿母轻笑了一声，然后对着羿锋笑道：“好了，锋儿，那你和我说说你的假理想是什么？”

羿锋微微一笑道：“不求**惊天下，但求猥琐动世人。纸醉金迷是我的追求，荒淫无度是我的梦想。恩，也就是传说中的纨绔子弟，败家子。”

牛，太他妈牛了。羿流听羿锋说完，心头就忍不住感叹道。明眼人一听，就知道这后面的话才是他真正的理想，这理想，简直就是堕落的极致。这小子居然还敢当着父亲，当着这么多人的面说出来，简直太牛逼了。

羿锋望着一个个惊呆在原地的众人，嘴角闪过一丝弧度：没错，这就是我的理想，虽然这些词都是贬义词。可是羿锋相信，男人都向往。

纸醉金迷，荒淫无度这些词都是穷人赋予到富人身上的，也可以认为是弱者赋予到强者身上的。要想过这样的生活，那你就必须比别人强，比别人富有。要不然，你根本就没有过这样生活的资本。它们的另一个意义是——要想堕落的越彻底，那你就必须的越强。纸醉金迷，荒淫无度，只有有足够的权势，金钱才能玩转的起来。

秦依听到羿锋的话，她愣愣的呆立在原地，脸上的惊骇，配合着她美绝人寰，诱人至极。这堕落到极致的话，让她心头难过万分，羿锋会有这样堕落理想的原因，再次归结于自己。毕竟，是自己让羿锋经脉俱断的。

中年男子和众人的反应一样，愣在了原地，他没有想到，居然有人敢冒天下之大不韪，说出这样的理想，难道羿锋就不怕世间卫道士来评击吗？！

可是，一个个想到羿锋是一个经脉俱断的废人，也就恍然了。一个废人而已，世人就算鄙视他，也不会浪费时间去评击他。也难怪这小子如此肆无忌惮了。

“果然是烂泥糊不上墙，废人，也就只能有这样堕落的理想。”艾伯特当然不会放弃这个打击羿锋的机会，他丝毫不掩饰的讥讽道。

羿锋玩味的看了一眼艾伯特，然后调侃的笑道：“你就这么确定我是废人？！你难道没听说过咸鱼也会翻身一说？”

艾伯特哼道：“我就算再无知，也知道，一个经脉俱断的人，是不可能成为武者的。既然不是武者，那不是废人是什么？难不成你还能如同萧公一样，才绝天下不成。”

“呵呵……”羿锋笑了笑，没有解释，对于一个马上要走入死亡的人。他没什么值得计较的。

“艾伯特爵士，请你说话注意点！”羿流哼声道，他不允许有人侮辱自己的弟弟。

连被两个小辈冷声相对的艾伯特，心中的怒火再次升了一个层次，他讥笑道：“难道你认为他不是废人不成。”

羿流冷哼道：“起码我不认为可以抛出日级……”

“大哥！”羿锋见羿流想用日级低阶灵技证明他的观点，他赶紧急声打断道，有些事情，是不能让外人知道的，“别说了，那没什么值得显摆的。我不过是在一堆垃圾里面找了一本看的上眼的给你而已。你别再说了，我可不像天天有人追着我要垃圾。”

羿流的脸抽搐了起来：一堆垃圾？！日级低阶功法啊，你居然说他是垃圾，还是用堆来形容，你还让不让人活了。小弟啊，你这五年到底去做什么了？！

羿流深吸了一口气，嘴角微微**。让旁边的人莫名其妙。

中年男子似乎很喜欢看相争的场面，见羿锋两兄弟没有和艾伯特计较的意思，这才虚伪的走出来打圆场道：“呵呵，艾伯特爵士，年轻人不懂事，你就别和他们一般见识了。当然，我也相信羿锋贤侄就算成不了灵者，也会是一个人才。”

艾伯特被以为可以借着羿凯幕小儿子废人的名头掉羿凯幕的面子，却不曾想到反被羿锋数次掉了颜面，心中当然有所不甘。

可是，艾伯特刚想说些什么的时候，却被羿锋打断：“咦。艾伯特爵士，你肩膀上是什么东西啊，来，来，来。我帮你拍掉去。”

说完，不理会众人的惊愕，羿锋快速的迈了几步，在艾伯特的肩膀上轻拍两下。而后再次坐回座位。

秦依和羿流面面相窥，对羿锋的行为十分疑惑，他们可不认为羿锋真的这么好心帮他拍灰尘，这小子可记仇的很呢。

艾伯特在羿锋拍两下之后，莫名的闪过了一丝不安，可是看了看自己的肩膀，他又自嘲的笑了笑，居然让一个废人拍两下就心慌了。

就在艾伯特为自己的心慌暗自嘲笑的时候，一句惨烈的尖叫猛的在前厅响起，让所有人的目光转向声音的来源处。

"Of course I'm telling the truth." The middle-aged man obviously didn't expect Yifeng to say that. He looked at Yifeng and smiled.

Yi Feng said categorically: "As a man, I naturally want to protect my family and my country. The rise of the empire is my ideal. If the empire wants me to live, I will live. If the empire wants me to sacrifice, I will never look back. My ideal exists only for the people and the empire. The empire is my blood, the empire is my favorite, the empire is..."

Yi Liu's face turned slightly red as he listened to Yi Feng's continuous and high-sounding words.Looking at the drooling little brother, I couldn't help but despise in my heart: Mom, how could I have such a shameless little brother? If he doesn't blush, I will blush for him.You are still protecting your family and country. I guarantee that if something happens to the empire, you kid will run faster than anyone else.

Everyone sighed in unison: It is a state to be so thick-skinned.

"Okay, okay. Nephew, I know your loyalty to the empire and your lofty ideals. You can stop." The middle-aged man wiped the cold sweat from his forehead and felt sick to his stomach at Yifeng's shameless bombardment.

Fake, too fake.No matter how you look at it, you are a slippery boy. If you were really that great, then there would be no justice in the world.

Everyone's faces became slightly hot. Although they were often hypocritical, they had never been hypocritical to this extent. Everyone couldn't help but sigh in their hearts: Shameless and invincible.We still have to practice slowly.

Yi's mother chuckled, then smiled at Yi Feng and said, "Okay, Feng'er, tell me what your fantasy is?"

Yifeng smiled slightly and said: "I don't want to shock the world with my sex, but I want to impress the world with my wretchedness. Indulgence and extravagance is my pursuit, and debauchery is my dream. Well, he is also the legendary dandy and prodigal son."

Awesome, so damn awesome.After Yi Liu heard what Yi Feng said, he couldn't help but sigh in his heart.As soon as a discerning person hears this, he will know that what follows is his true ideal. This ideal is simply the acme of depravity.This kid actually dared to say it in front of his father and so many people. It was so awesome.

Yifeng looked at everyone who was stunned in place, and a hint of arc flashed at the corner of his mouth: Yes, this is my ideal, although these words are derogatory terms.But Yifeng believes that all men yearn for it.

Words such as drunkenness and dissoluteness are given by the poor to the rich, and can also be considered to be given by the weak to the strong.If you want to live such a life, you must be better than others and richer than others.Otherwise, you simply don’t have the capital to live such a life.Another meaning of them is - the more completely you want to fall, the stronger you must be.Indulgent and extravagant, only with enough power can money be played.

When Qin Yi heard Yifeng's words, she stood there blankly, the horror on her face matched her beauty and allure.This depravity to the extreme made her feel extremely sad. The reason why Yifeng had such a depraved ideal was once again attributed to herself.After all, it was him who cut off all of Yifeng's meridians.

The middle-aged man had the same reaction as everyone else. He was stunned. He didn't expect that someone would dare to risk the world's disapproval and speak out such an ideal. Isn't Yifeng afraid of criticism from the world's defenders?!

However, everyone suddenly realized that Yifeng was a cripple with all his meridians broken.He is just a useless person. Even if the world despises him, they will not waste time criticizing him.No wonder this kid is so unscrupulous.

"Sure enough, mud can't stick to the wall, and useless people can only have such degenerate ideals." Of course, Albert would not give up this opportunity to attack Yi Feng, he said sarcastically without concealing it.

Yi Feng glanced at Albert playfully, and then said with a teasing smile: "Are you so sure that I am a cripple?! Haven't you ever heard that salted fish can turn over?"

Albert snorted: "No matter how ignorant I am, I still know that it is impossible for a person with severed meridians to become a warrior. Since he is not a warrior, what is he but a useless person? Is it possible that you can still be like Mr. Xiao, who is unparalleled in the world?"

"Haha..." Yifeng smiled without explaining, for a person who was about to die.He has nothing to worry about.

"Sir Albert, please be careful what you say!" Yi Liu snorted. He would not allow anyone to insult his brother.

Albert, who was treated coldly by two juniors, felt the anger in his heart rise to a new level again. He sneered, "Don't you think he is a useless person?"

Yi Liu snorted coldly: "At least I don't think it's possible to throw out the Japanese level..."

"Brother!" Yi Feng saw that Yi Liu wanted to use Japanese low-level spiritual skills to prove his point. He hurriedly interrupted. There are some things that cannot be known to outsiders. "Stop talking, it's nothing worth showing off. I just found an interesting book among a pile of rubbish and gave it to you. Stop talking. It's not like people are chasing me for rubbish every day."

Yi Liu's face twitched: a pile of garbage?!Japanese-level low-level skills, you actually call him garbage, and you still use the word "heap" to describe him, and you still don't let people live.Little brother, what have you been doing in the past five years?!

Yi Liu took a deep breath, and the corners of his mouth curled up slightly.Make the people next to you confused.

The middle-aged man seemed to enjoy watching the fight. Seeing that the two brothers Yi Feng had no intention of arguing with Albert, he came out hypocritically to smooth things over and said: "Haha, Sir Albert, young people are not sensible, so don't get along with them. Of course, I also believe that nephew Yi Feng will be a talent even if he cannot become a spiritual person."

Albert thought that he could lose Yi Kaimu's face by using the name of Yi Kaimu's youngest son, useless person, but he never expected that he would be humiliated by Yi Feng several times. Of course, he felt unwilling to do so.

However, when Albert was about to say something, he was interrupted by Yifeng: "Hey. Sir Albert, what is that on your shoulder? Come on, come on, come on. Let me pat it off for you."

After saying that, ignoring everyone's astonishment, Yifeng took a few quick steps and tapped Albert twice on the shoulder.Then he sat back down again.

Qin Yi and Yi Liu looked at each other and were very confused about Yi Feng's behavior. They didn't think Yi Feng was really so kind to help him dust off the dust. This kid can hold a grudge very much.

After being slapped twice by Yi Feng, Albert felt an inexplicable flash of uneasiness, but looking at his own shoulder, he smiled to himself, for he was actually flustered after being slapped twice by a useless person.

Just when Albert was secretly laughing at his panic, a tragic scream suddenly sounded in the front hall, causing everyone's eyes to turn to the source of the sound.
